title: Scaling Results for Piecewise Deterministic Monte Carlo : A Survey
summary: Piecewise Deterministic Monte Carlo (PDMC) algorithms utilize continuous time Markov processes to generate samples from continuous distributions, and provide a modern alternative to discrete time Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms. In this work we provide a survey of recent results on scaling limit arguments to understand the behaviour and efficiency of two often-used Piecewise Deterministic Monte Carlo algorithms: the Bouncy Particle Sampler and the Zig-Zag Process.
